settings.value: The certification route is the same whether the car is a AED 30,000 hatchback or a AED 200,000 SUV. Nothing is priced until it has been through all five.
A full check of engine, transmission, brakes, suspension, electrics, air conditioning and bodywork by our own technicians.
Registration, accident and service history pulled and read before the car is accepted for sale. Anything unclear is declined.
Wear items replaced and faults corrected at Vesla Auto Service Center using genuine parts, not the cheapest available.
The car is signed off under the Vesla Certified Pre Owned label, with the inspection record handed to the buyer.
An extended warranty is offered on eligible cars, serviceable at our own centre rather than a third-party workshop.
Name and title as published on veslamotors.com. No statement from the chairman and no portrait are quoted here because neither has been supplied.

Vesla Motors is the retail end of the automotive platform held by MRM Investment LLC, and it has traded in Dubai under the same ownership since 1988. Service, leasing, rental and resale sit under that same roof — which is why a car bought here can be serviced, re-leased or sold back without ever leaving the group.

Every car passes a five-stage route: a full mechanical and bodywork inspection, a registration, accident and service history report, reconditioning with genuine parts at Vesla Auto Service Center, certification with the inspection record handed to the buyer, and an extended warranty on eligible cars.
What does a Vesla Certified Pre Owned car include?
Yes. Bring the car to either UAE branch for a physical valuation, or use the online estimator for an indicative range first. Trade-ins can be set against any car in stock.
Does Vesla Motors buy used cars in Dubai?
Vesla Motors has traded in Dubai since 1988 under the same ownership, and has been named a Dubizzle Top Dealer for three consecutive years.

Thirty-six years on the same street corner of the trade.

Vesla Motors is the retail end of the group’s automotive platform. It has been trading in Dubai since 1988, and it does one thing: buy good used cars, put them right, and sell them with the paperwork to prove it.

Founding year, branch count and the Dubizzle Top Dealer award are taken from veslamotors.com. Annual sales volume is described there as “thousands of cars annually” and is not stated as a figure, so it is not shown here.
Bring the car to either branch for a physical valuation, or start with the estimator here to get a sense of the range before you drive over. Trade-ins are set against anything on the floor.

Service, leasing, rental and resale all sit under the same owner. When your needs change, you move companies rather than suppliers.
